description: Add one dated update to a project's PROJECT.md: a Communications Log row plus the matching change in Quotes, Supplier Orders, Key Decisions or Documents. Rule: only ever append rows; never delete or rewrite existing rows.

steps.description: Confirm project_path exists and contains a PROJECT.md. Capture project_md_path and project_md_existed_before_run (must be true).

Check update_type is one of comms_log_only, new_quote, supplier_order_change, key_decision, document_added, status_change. Capture update_type_validated and target_sections (the list of sections that will change).
Write the new Communications Log row in the format '| YYYY-MM-DD | IN or OUT | Who | Subject | Summary |'. Capture comms_log_row.
For each section in target_sections, write the exact lines to append. Capture section_changes (an object mapping section name to the new lines).

Append comms_log_row and section_changes to PROJECT.md and update the 'Last Updated' line. Keep every existing line. Capture pre_edit_byte_size, post_edit_byte_size (must not be smaller) and lines_added.
